dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Pe ñe'ẽ kóva guahu, tapicha porã hína, ¿mba'eicha pe ñe'ẽkuaáva akaháma?
dialogue.translation: This word is really beautiful, it's of a good person. Why is this word easy to remember?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Upe ñe'ẽ téra 'libertad' pa. Upéicha guaháma ohecha hese.
dialogue.translation: That word is called 'libertad' (freedom) then. That's really how it's seen in it.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: ¡Jajái! Pe ñe'ẽkuaáva kuéra akaháma porã, oime peteĩte libre pa.
dialogue.translation: Wow! These words are easy to remember, even though there's one that's free, then.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Aháma porã oñe'ẽ haguã libertad-pe. Pero oñondive, ñe'ẽ ha libertad upéichaite oñemoĩva.
dialogue.translation: It's easy to talk about freedom. But at the same time, the word and freedom don't always align that way.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Guahu, libertad upéichaite oñemoĩva. Upéichaite tapicha kuéra oñe'ẽ haguã ñembohory ha ñemomarãngatú.
dialogue.translation: Actually, freedom doesn't align that way. That's how people speak to generate joy and well-being.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Pero oñe'ẽ haguã libertad, oñeikotevẽ mba'eve pa térã oñe'ẽ ramo.
dialogue.translation: But to talk about freedom, do you need something or is it just talking?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Upéichaite oñeikotevẽ. Oñe'ẽ haguã libertad, oñeikotevẽ ñe'ẽ porã ha ñembo'e kuéra.
dialogue.translation: That's right, it's needed. To talk about freedom, you need beautiful words and acts of teaching.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Pe ñe'ẽkuaáva kuéra akaháma porã. Upéichaite oiko ñe'ẽ ha libertad-pe.
dialogue.translation: These words are easy to remember. That's how the word and freedom work.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: — Aipota ñandéve avei ñemombe'u pype ta'anga. Péiva oñha'ã jepe ko mba'apo.
dialogue.translation: — We also want to include a news report based on images. That will be a good attempt for this work.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: — Mba'éichapa oñemombe'u hína niko ta'anga? ¿Etevépa oñeha'ã péva?
dialogue.translation: — How do you report the news based on the image? Will it really be a good attempt?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: — Hetaite oñembo'e pype ko ta'anga. Péicha oñeha'ã mbovy ñandéve.
dialogue.translation: — There are many elements in this image. That's how we'll try with more care.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: — Péicha chéve avei. Pero upéicha oñeho pype viró tapy.
dialogue.translation: — That's how it seems to me too. But we'll get it done quickly, right?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: — Ahaháta peteĩ ñemombe'u viró rawi. ¿Etevépa oñeha'ã peteĩve?
dialogue.translation: — We'll make a news report today itself. Will it be just one?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: — Javy, mbovy pe ñemombe'u. Ndaha'éi peteĩve.
dialogue.translation: — No, there are several more. It's not just one.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: — Upéa péva oñemombe'úta. Pero mba'apo porãve ojeity pype.
dialogue.translation: — We'll include that. But the work must be done well.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: — Ojeity pype viró. Nda upéi ndaha'éi mba'eve.
dialogue.translation: — We'll get it done quickly. There won't be any problem afterward.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: — Pe ñemombe'u oñemombe'úta hína. ¡Tapy oñembo'e pype ta'anga!
dialogue.translation: — We'll include this news report now. Immediately, we'll examine the elements in the image!

key_phrases.translation: To examine elements immediately

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Tové mboyve ñe'ẽ rerohory pya'e, upéi jojaha tape tembiapópe ikatu jajapo mba'eve ñande.
dialogue.translation: Aún antes de escuchar tu discurso recién, entonces podemos reunirnos para hacer algo juntos.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Véva ikatu jajapo, ipahápe ndaipóri mba'eve jeguata haguã umi tembiapópe.
dialogue.translation: Aunque podemos hacerlo, a causa de que no hay nada para avanzar en estos proyectos.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ndaijai, jeheka ñandéve heta mba'eve japo haguã, upéi ikatu jajapo pya'e.
dialogue.translation: No me rindo, intentamos varias cosas para hacer, entonces podemos empezar ahora mismo.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Upéi, ikatu jojaha umi pyahu, ipahápe ojeheka mba'eve jepeve oñemombe'úva.
dialogue.translation: Entonces, podemos reunir a los jóvenes, a causa de que buscan incluso lo que no se menciona.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ko mba'e mbovy jepeve oñemboja'o umi tembiapópe, ikatu jajapo pya'e.
dialogue.translation: Estas cosas apenas se corrompen en los proyectos, entonces podemos empezar rápido.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Tové ikatu jajapo, véva ipahápe ndaipóri mba'eve oñoikotevẽva.
dialogue.translation: Aún podemos hacerlo, aunque no hay nada que sea necesario para empezar.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Upéi, ikatu jojaha umi ndive ikatuva'ekue, ipahápe oñembo'e jepeve ojejapo haguã.
dialogue.translation: Entonces, podemos reunirnos con quienes pueden, a causa de que incluso ellos quieren trabajar juntos.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Tové ikatu, pero mbovy jepeve oñemboja'o, ipahápe ndaipóri mba'eve jepeve ajapo haguã.
dialogue.translation: Aún podemos, pero apenas hay cosas que se corrompen, a causa de que no hay nada que hacer para mejorar.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Tovevéva, jajaha pya'e, ipahápe umi ikatuva'ekue ikatu jajapo haguã.
dialogue.translation: Todavía, reunámonos ahora mismo, a causa de que quienes pueden quizás puedan hacerlo.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: ¿Mba'e pyaha ohecha heta jepy oñemba'eguasu yvy ári oñeha'ã mba'eapo ai ñandeve?
dialogue.translation: What is the reason that there are so many risks to our freedom when we try to act on the earth?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ha'e katu chemohu'ã heta tembiapo katu oiko oñemba'eguasu, oñeha'ã moĩ ñandeve jepe.
dialogue.translation: I think that they only generate many actions that, even if they are close to our freedom, ultimately limit it.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Upe tembiapo oñeha'ã ñandeve oñemba'eguasu oñemba'ereko oikóva ite.
dialogue.translation: Those actions that limit our freedom leave us with a false sense of autonomy, don’t they?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Katu, ñande ojeporú tembiapokue katu oheja tembiapo oñemba'eguasu, oïma ta'anga ikatúva.
dialogue.translation: Exactly. We use current actions only to leave freedom behind, don’t you see that danger exists?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Che ai, mba'e ikatu oñemba'eguasu ñande tapykue oñeha'ã tembiapo oikóva.
dialogue.translation: I think that freedom is only close when we stop acting in that way.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ha'eite, oïma tembiapo oñemba'eguasu oñemba'ereko oñeha'ã oñepyrũ.
dialogue.translation: Yes, exactly. There are actions that, when we start them with a false sense of freedom, end up limiting it from the beginning.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Pe tembiapo oñeha'ã ñandeve oñemba'eguasu oñeha'ã ai yvype oñemba'ereko ite.
dialogue.translation: Those actions that limit our freedom to impose things on the earth leave us with a false sense of autonomy.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Upéicharã, chemohu'ã opaichagua tembiapo oñemba'eguasu oñeha'ã jepe, oñemba'ereko ite.
dialogue.translation: That’s why I think that all those actions, even if they claim to be about freedom, leave us with a false sense of autonomy.

key_phrases.translation: Those actions that limit our freedom...

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: ¿Mba'ére nde iporavopyré upéicha? Iñaña upéicha kamby oñemyasãi.
dialogue.translation: Why is that false in this way? Here, milk spills like this.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Upéicha jepy'a ñande mombyry oñemohu'ã haguã ha'e porãva.
dialogue.translation: Thus, the heart that is far away is admired because it is good.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: ¿Ta'anga mombyke ñande reho? Upe ñepyrũ jepe oñembo'e haguã.
dialogue.translation: Does the image go between us? Even this beginning is taught for that purpose.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Aha upéi jeporeka upéicha ha'eva'erã ñande reho.
dialogue.translation: Then I will go to search in this way for what must be done for our path.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Poravopyré upéicha oñemyasãi kamby. Mombyry jepy'a ñande omba'apo.
dialogue.translation: It is false that milk spills this way. The heart where we work is far away.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ñande ñepyrũ mombyke jajeporeka upéicha haguã.
dialogue.translation: Our beginning is amid this so that we may search in this way.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Kamby oñembo'e tapykue ha'e upéicha jepe.

dialogue.speaker: B

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: ¿Pe mba'e jui ohechávo mba'éicha oiko heta ñe'ẽrã oñemoñe'ẽ hína?
dialogue.translation: What is the purpose of seeing how many speeches developed at that time?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ojehechávo ñe'ẽrã katu ohasávo ñembo'e mba'éichapa ojejapo umi ñeha'ã oñeha'ã.
dialogue.translation: By analyzing speeches, lessons can be extracted on how goals were achieved.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Upéi, mba'é mbeguapu ohesa'ỹva umi jepy oñemoña jaguápe.
dialogue.translation: So, what is the meaning of not achieving those changes in the historical context?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ñe'ẽkôi ojehecháta kamba'e ikatu oñemoñe'ẽ upévape, aipóva ñeha'ã oñeha'ãiva mba'eapo.
dialogue.translation: Even though another aspect is analyzed, that can explain why certain goals were achieved in collective action.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Mba'éicha ojehechagua mba'éichapa oñeha'ãvo umi ñembo'eguasu oñemoñe'ẽ hína.
dialogue.translation: How are the ways in which great teachings were formed during that period analyzed?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Oñeha'ãvo pe mba'eapo, oñe'ẽrã hína ohecháta mba'éichapa ojejapo jepevéva umi ñeha'ã oñeha'ã.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Jui apy pe mba'eapo oñeha'ãva ñembo'eguasu, ndaipóri kamba'e oñemoñe'ẽva mba'éichapa.
dialogue.translation: Since long ago, that action has had great goals, but there is no other way to explain how it was done.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Aipóva ñe'ẽkôi ojehecháta heta ñe'ẽrã oñemoñe'ẽva mba'éichapa oiko umi jepy oñemoña jaguápe.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Nde aju ndive, ¿mba'éichapa henda ta'anga ñe'ẽ ha tova ndive?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ñe'ẽ ha tova ñe añe henda ndive mbue teko mba'eapo mokõin.
dialogue.translation: Speech and the face remain together in a small act of existence, both of them.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ha upéi, ¿mba'éichapa ta'anga ñe'ẽ ñande ndive ndive oikotevẽva?
dialogue.translation: And then, how does the image of speech that we need alongside us become necessary?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ñe'ẽ ñande ndive ndive oñe'ẽ hendáicha ojeikuaa mokõi ta'anga.
dialogue.translation: Speech alongside us is expressed in a way that recognizes both images.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Che aipota jehecha mba'éichapa ta'anga oñeha'ã ojeheka tova ñe'ẽ ndive.
dialogue.translation: I want to see how the image prepares itself while seeking the face of speech.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Tova oñeha'ã hendáicha tata mobype ojeikuaa jepe mokõi mona.
dialogue.translation: The face prepares itself like fire that recognizes even the two crazy ones.

dialogue.speaker: A

dialogue.text: Ha'e upéi oheko la contradicción. Oñeha'ãite oñondive upécha iguá ñande jahecha.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Pe mba'éicha ohecha ha'e ojehechávo reikotevẽva umi mba'e oñepyrũ haguã? Péva rire, pe kuña ára upe tendáve oñe'ẽrã peteĩ ñe'ẽ mba'e.
dialogue.translation: ¿Cómo se observa que es necesario empezar ciertas cosas? Después de eso, esa mujer del lugar allá promete una palabra al respecto.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Amo, he'i añe'ẽvéva. Ojehauka umi mba'e oñeikotevẽva haguã. Péicha oñemoĩ peteĩ tetãme oñepyrỹi mba'e.
dialogue.translation: Sí, es así lo que digo. Se investigan las cosas que hacen falta. Así se inicia una comunidad que construye algo.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Upéi, pe kuña rehe peteĩ rehe, ¿mba'ére upévare oñe'ẽrã peteĩ ñe'ẽ mba'e? Ndahai mba'erãve oñe'ẽrã.
dialogue.translation: Entonces, respecto a esa mujer, ¿por qué promete una palabra sobre algo? No promete nada sin motivo.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ndaijavéi, oñe'ẽrã haguã umi mba'e oñemoĩva peteĩ tetãme. Péva rire, oñemoĩ rehe peteĩ peteĩ ñe'ẽ.
dialogue.translation: No es distinto, promete por las cosas que se inician en una comunidad. Después de eso, se añade una palabra por una.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Upéi, pe kuña oñemoĩ peteĩ tetãme, ¿pe rehe kuña oñe'ẽrã peteĩ ñe'ẽ mba'e peteĩ ñe'ẽ chupe? ¿Ko'áĝa oñemopu'ã rehe peteĩ ñe'ẽ?
dialogue.translation: Entonces, esa mujer inicia una comunidad, ¿por ella promete una palabra sobre algo? ¿O ahora levanta una palabra por algo?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ha'eve, oñe'ẽrã peteĩ ñe'ẽ mba'e peteĩ tetãme rehe. Péicha oñembohetave umi mba'e oñemoĩva, ha upéicha oñeikotevẽva rehe.
dialogue.translation: Sí, promete una palabra sobre algo en la comunidad. Así se fortalece lo que se inicia, y de esa manera se hace necesario.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ko'áĝa, pe kuña oñe'ẽvéva peteĩ ñe'ẽ mba'e péva, ¿mba'éicha oñemboaje umi mba'e oñemoĩva haguã?
dialogue.translation: Ahora, esa mujer dice una palabra al respecto, ¿cómo se valora lo que se inicia?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Oñemboaje mba'eve rehe oñe'ẽrã haguã. Péicha oñemoĩ umi mba'e oñepyrũ haguã, ha oñe'ẽrã peteĩ ñe'ẽ mba'e peteĩ tetãme rehe.
dialogue.translation: Se valora por lo que promete. Así se inicia lo que se necesita empezar, y se promete una palabra en la comunidad.

key_phrases.phrase: Pe mba'éicha ohecha ha'e ojehechávo reikotevẽva umi mba'e oñepyrũ haguã?
key_phrases.translation: How is it observed that certain things need to be started?

key_phrases.phrase: Péva rire, pe kuña ára upe tendáve oñe'ẽrã peteĩ ñe'ẽ mba'e.
key_phrases.translation: After that, that woman from that distant place makes a promise about something.

key_phrases.phrase: Ndaijavéi, oñe'ẽrã haguã umi mba'e oñemoĩva peteĩ tetãme.
key_phrases.translation: It's no different; she makes a promise for the things that are initiated in a community.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Upe tenda ñepytyvõ ha jajá peteĩ mba'e porãite ojeikotevẽva.
dialogue.translation: That place needs support and we must begin something truly necessary.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: ¿Mba'e rere rejoguaha pe mbarakaja?
dialogue.translation: What opinion do you have about this approach?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ajahá javeve ñepytyvõicha oñembokyre'ỹva, upévare ojeikotevẽ mba'eete.
dialogue.translation: We must act right away to help without mistakes, because this is truly important.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ha katu mba'e mbegue ojejapo rire haguã jepe oñeikotevẽva.
dialogue.translation: But what mistakes are made even when acting with good intentions?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Jave upéicha, ñepo ojejapo jey rire ohechauka ñande mba'eete.
dialogue.translation: Sometimes, the habit of repeating mistakes reveals our true intention.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Che rereha oikotevẽ ñande mba'e porãite ojejapo mbegue'i.
dialogue.translation: My opinion is that we need to do truly good things without making small mistakes.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Mba'e mbarakaja rejoguaha haguã ojeikotevẽva ñande mba'e porãite oñembokyre'ỹva.
dialogue.translation: What approach will we adopt to achieve what we truly need without making mistakes?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Jajá javeve, because ojeikotevẽva ñande mba'e porãite rehe.
dialogue.translation: Let's start right away, because we truly need this.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ha avei, mba'e rere rejoguaha pe mbarakaja porãite rehe.
dialogue.translation: And also, what opinion do you have about this truly good approach?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Che kuaa upéicha tapy ñe'ẽ oñemohu'ã ha ohechakuaa hesakã post-colonial.
dialogue.translation: Yo sé que a menudo las palabras se transforman y se aprecian desde perspectivas poscoloniales.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Nde kuaa peteĩ tekotevẽ rehegua mbo'eha gueteri. Upéicha avei ñande kuaa oñe'ẽvo post-colonial.
dialogue.translation: Tú conoces un aspecto fundamental de la enseñanza. Así también nosotros conocemos y hablamos de postcolonial.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Mba'eve ojehecha mbo'eha upéicha. Ajévo oñemohu'ã ojehechakuaa mba'eveve.
dialogue.translation: De ninguna manera se ve la enseñanza así. Aunque se transforma, se sigue viendo nada en absoluto.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Che nda'akuaái mba'eve katu oñe'ẽvo post-colonial térã mba'éicha oñemohu'ã ñe'ẽ.

dialogue.speaker: A

dialogue.speaker: B

dialogue.speaker: A
